visualCharacteristics.purpose: Commerce product listing grid with an optional promo tile
visualCharacteristics.description: 4-up grid (2-up mobile) of bordered light-grey product cards: square swatch image with an optional 'New' badge top-left, small vendor line, linked product name and price; the whole card links to the product. A promo tile (photo with a bold title and a CTA button overlaid) can sit in the grid, typically first.

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: image cell, then a text cell. Product: optional badge paragraph ('New'), vendor paragraph, linked product name, price paragraph. Promo: bold title paragraph (or heading) and a CTA link
contentPattern.rationale: Repeating look-alike items that each link to a product detail page: Cards. The dynamic product list is captured as static authored rows.

reuseGuidance: Use for product listings where each card carries a vendor, linked name and price. Use cards-swatch when items are only an image and a linked name.
usageDescription: Product grid (4-up desktop, 2-up mobile). One row per tile: image cell; text cell with an optional badge paragraph ('New') first, then the vendor, the linked product name, and the price. A row whose text has a bold title (or heading) and a link is rendered as a promo tile with the image behind the text. 'Add to cart' and hover image swap are not migrated.
